note: The platform surface matrix. Single source of truth for both docs/compatibility.md (generated between markers by scripts/build_compat.py) and the Compatibility view on the site, so the two can never disagree. A dash means the surface does not expose that concept. A platform's docs_url is a page of its documentation whose address names a model version (the vendor's known limitations of the current model): hand-written docs may link only the versioned pages recorded here, so a release that moves the page turns every stale link red. A platform's catalog_platforms lists the values a catalogue row records in `platforms` for that surface; scripts/lint.py holds every value a row records to these lists and to taxonomy.json's platforms_without_surface. granularity "coarse" marks a surface whose value does not tell it apart from another route: a row records vercel-ai-gateway, not which of the gateway's two routes it takes, and typesafe-api, not whether it reaches the native API directly or through a pass-through beside it; so a row counted under a coarse surface may use another. No row's value is guessed finer than its evidence shows.

platforms.name: TypeSafe API (direct)
platforms.notes: The reference surface. A model-assisted documentation check on 2026-10-15 covered only the native API: jev-preview points to jev-1.14.0; jev-latest still points to jev-1.13.0. Other surfaces retain the matrix's 2026-09-22 reading date.
platforms.notes_zh: 基准面。2026-10-15 的模型辅助文档核对仅覆盖原生 API：jev-preview 指向 jev-1.14.0，jev-latest 仍指向 jev-1.13.0。其他平台仍沿用矩阵的 2026-09-22 阅读日期。

platforms.name: Vercel AI SDK evaluation API
platforms.notes: The one surface that renames the primitive. Needs AI SDK 7.0.105 or newer.
platforms.notes_zh: 唯一给原语改了名字的平台。需要 AI SDK 7.0.105 及以上。

platforms.name: Vercel AI Gateway (TypeSafe-compatible)
platforms.notes: Same gateway as the row above, different route, different spelling. Pick one and stay on it.
platforms.notes_zh: 和上一行是同一个网关，但路径不同、拼法也不同。选一条走，别混用。

platforms.name: @ai-sdk/typesafe-ai
platforms.notes: Note the env var: TYPESAFE_AI_API_KEY, not TYPESAFE_API_KEY.
platforms.notes_zh: 注意环境变量是 TYPESAFE_AI_API_KEY，不是 TYPESAFE_API_KEY。

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
platforms.notes: The envelope differs: state and questions sit inside an `input` object. A native client cannot be ported by swapping the URL.
platforms.notes_zh: 请求结构不同：state 和 questions 被包在 `input` 对象里。原生客户端不能只换 URL 就移植。

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.endpoint: a decisions endpoint, separate from chat
platforms.notes: Note the tilde on the alias. The listing page carries no code sample, so the request shape was left unrecorded rather than guessed.
platforms.notes_zh: 注意别名前面那个波浪号。该页没有代码示例，所以请求结构此处留空而非猜测。

platforms.name: LiteLLM pass-through
platforms.notes: Exposes the native path, so the official SDK works by changing only the base URL.
platforms.notes_zh: 暴露的是原生路径，官方 SDK 只需改 base URL 即可使用。

platforms.name: Bifrost
platforms.notes: One-to-one pass-through of the native API.
platforms.notes_zh: 对原生 API 做一比一透传。

platforms.name: AI/ML API
platforms.notes: A third endpoint path. Top-level envelope like native, but not at the native path.
platforms.notes_zh: 第三种端点路径。请求结构与原生一致，但路径不同。

platforms.name: Netlify AI Gateway
platforms.notes: The lowest-friction route if you already deploy there: no key, no base URL, billed through the platform. Node.js 20+.
platforms.notes_zh: 如果你本来就部署在 Netlify，这是门槛最低的路径：不需要密钥、不需要 baseURL，按平台计费。需 Node.js 20+。

platforms.name: Pydantic AI
platforms.notes: Maps Python types onto primitives: bool becomes a noul, Literal becomes a choice, an ordered IntEnum becomes a score.
platforms.notes_zh: 把 Python 类型映射到原语：bool 变成 noul，Literal 变成 choice，有序 IntEnum 变成 score。

platforms.name: LangChain
platforms.notes: Accessor differs from the quickstart's: .nouls[key] rather than .answers[key]. Follow whichever your SDK version documents.
platforms.notes_zh: 取值方式与官方 quickstart 不同：用 .nouls[key] 而非 .answers[key]。按你自己 SDK 版本的文档来。

platforms.name: rig (Rust)
platforms.notes: A third env var name, and the 255-option cap is enforced at compile time.
platforms.notes_zh: 第三种环境变量名；而且 255 选项上限是在编译期强制的。

limits.why: Walk a hierarchy with a beam search over probabilities to get past it.
limits.why_zh: 要突破它，就用对概率做 beam search 的方式遍历层级。

limits.why: A score is probability-weighted, so it lands between levels. Do not assume an integer.
limits.why_zh: score 是概率加权的，会落在两级之间。不要假设它是整数。

limits.v: default: 64k tokens per request; 32k for state plus the longest question
limits.why: On native jev-1.14.0 and jev-1.13.0, the experimental TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Long-Context: true header raises both limits to 262k; it is slower and less accurate. See https://docs.typesafe.ai/models#long-context. No tokenizer is published; leave headroom when budgeting input.
limits.why_zh: 原生 jev-1.14.0 和 jev-1.13.0 可通过实验性请求头 TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Long-Context: true 将两项限制均提高至 262k，但速度更慢、准确率更低。见 https://docs.typesafe.ai/models#long-context。官方没有公开 tokenizer；估算输入时应留余量。

limits.v: text by default: string, JSON object, or array; experimental PNG/JPEG images on the native API
limits.why: Native jev-1.14.0 and jev-1.13.0 accept experimental PNG/JPEG images with TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Images: true. See https://docs.typesafe.ai/images for the image request shape. Audio and video are unsupported; pre-process them to text or typed fields. Gateway support is unverified.
limits.why_zh: 原生 jev-1.14.0 和 jev-1.13.0 可通过 TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Images: true 启用实验性 PNG/JPEG 图像输入。图像请求结构见 https://docs.typesafe.ai/images。不支持音频和视频，须先转为文本或类型化字段。网关支持情况未经核实。

limits.v: free; the model generates no text
limits.why: Only input is charged, which is what makes per-item judgement at scale affordable.
limits.why_zh: 只对输入计费 —— 这正是大规模逐条判断得以负担的原因。

limits.why: The upstream API does not stream, so no gateway can add it.
limits.why_zh: 上游 API 本身不支持流式，因此任何网关都加不上。

limits.why: Anything that runs locally is a different model with a compatible wire format. Calibration does not transfer, so neither do thresholds.
limits.why_zh: 任何能本地运行的都是另一个模型，只是协议兼容。校准不会迁移，所以阈值也不会。

not_model_strings.why: The most repeated fabrication about this model. It appears in no vendor or gateway documentation; OpenRouter's string is typesafe/jev-1.13.
Not a model ID. The native API accepts jev-1.14.0, jev-1.13.0, jev-latest and jev-preview.
